research_notes: Issuer: PT Mayora Indah Tbk (same legal name in every FS2019-FS2025 and the 9M2026 FS; listed 1990). Packaged food and beverages - the website's brand categories are biscuits, confectionery, wafers, chocolate, coffee and health food. Major holders at 31 Dec 2025: PT Unita Branindo 32.93%, PT Mayora Dhana Utama 26.14%, Jogi Hendra Atmadja 25.24% (FS2025 Note 22, PDF p. 78).
Currency/units: IDR reporter. Every FS (FY2019-FY2025, 9M2026) is presented in FULL RUPIAH; money is stored in IDR billion = Rupiah / 1e9 with full precision.

Source documents: all from www.mayoraindah.co.id (no bot protection; fetched directly). The company publishes FS2019, FS2020 and FS2021 only as ZIP archives (source_url = the ZIP; loc names the member PDF), AR2023 as ZIP and AR2024 as 7z. The primary statements of FS2019, FS2021 and FS2022 are scanned images: they were read from page renders and every figure was matched to text sources (the condensed newspaper publications inside the FS2019/FS2021 ZIPs and the next year's comparative columns). FS2020, FS2023-FS2025 and 9M2026 are text PDFs.

RESTATEMENT (FY2019 only): FS2020 prints a revised 2019 comparative without any restatement note: current tax 661,306,449,500 (FS2019: 673,306,449,500), profit attributable 1,999,303,012,096 (FS2019: 1,987,755,412,096), equity attributable 9,674,413,679,800 (9,662,866,079,800), total equity 9,911,940,195,318 (9,899,940,195,318), taxes payable 184,860,464,005 (196,860,464,005). Revenue, total assets and cash are unchanged. fy.2019 stores the ORIGINAL FS2019 figures. All later comparatives equal the original figures (checked FY2020-FY2024); presentation-only reclassifications: FS2021 splits 2020 lease liabilities into current/non-current; FS2023 splits 2022 'other payables' into other payables + advances received; FS2025 moves 2024 employee-benefit payments inside 'cash generated from operations' (CFO total unchanged).

FS2023 on the website is the REISSUED version (auditor's report 00662/2.1090/AU.1/04/0153-2/1/V/2024 of 28 May 2024, issued for the Bond III Phase I offering with additional disclosures in Note 41); the original report 00425/... was dated 17 Apr 2024 (FS2023 PDF p. 7). Note 1 still says authorised 17 Apr 2024, used as EPS share_basis. The site's link for 'Laporan Keuangan Tahunan 2023' is named lkk---20241231.pdf although it holds the FY2023 FS.
EBITDA: not reported by Mayora in any FS, AR or the 2026 public-expose deck (EBITDA appears only inside loan/bond covenant wording); stored null, never computed.

Capex = 'Perolehan aset tetap' + 'Pembayaran uang muka pembelian aset tetap' (advances for PP&E). The advance line paid each year equals the year-end advances balance and is reclassified into PP&E the next year without cash, so 'Perolehan' alone understates cash capex (e.g. 2019: 438.5 bn acquisitions + 1,459.9 bn advances). Each capex note gives both lines.

Total debt = short-term bank loans + current and non-current bank loans + bonds (Obligasi Berkelanjutan I/II/III); always equals the FS capital-management 'Jumlah utang / Total borrowings'. Lease liabilities (PSAK 73, from 2020) excluded. Mayora has no sukuk outstanding since 2017.

Payout ratio as printed in the AR dividend tables uses PROFIT FOR THE YEAR INCLUDING NCI as denominator (e.g. FY2024 1,226,376,234,875 / 3,067,667,675,407 = 39.98%), so profit_attr x payout is 1.4-2.2% below the dividend total (within the 3% check). FY2025 payout is not printed anywhere yet -> null.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per fiscal year, no interim dividends (FS dividend notes FS2021-FS2025, 9M2026). DPS/totals from the FS notes (AGMS deeds) and the 2026 AGMS summary; cum/ex/recording/payment dates from the KSEI schedules (web.ksei.co.id, issuer-relayed). The older AGMS result PDFs on the company site (2019-2023) have empty download links; the 2025 AGMS result PDFs are scanned. FY2021 payment date conflict: KSEI 27 Jul 2022 vs AR '29 Juli 2022'.

Treasury shares: none until 2025. Buybacks: 60,950,000 shares 27 Mar-28 May 2025 (POJK 13/2023, no AGMS needed) and, under the EGMS of 10 Jun 2025 (max Rp1 tn, 11 Jun 2025-11 Jun 2026), 101,110,000 more by 31 Dec 2025 (AR2025 PDF p. 9) -> 162,060,000 at FY2025 (cost Rp349.9 bn) and 332,015,500 at 30 Sep 2026 (cost Rp673.4 bn). shares_out is net of treasury shares; the AR 'shares outstanding' text and market caps use the 22,358,699,725 issued shares.

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: none (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). Share history (company page 'Kronologis Pencatatan Saham' https://www.mayoraindah.co.id/content/Kronologis-Pencatatan-Saham-Obligasi-dan-Sukuk-67 and AR2025 PDF p. 43-44): last bonus issue 2013 (6 held : 1 bonus), last split 2016 (1:25, Rp500 -> Rp20 nominal; 22,358,699,725 shares ever since). The 'Aksi Korporasi' sections of AR2019 (PDF p. 5), AR2020 (p. 5), AR2021 (p. 6), AR2022 (p. 6), AR2023 (p. 6), AR2024 (p. 8) and AR2025 (p. 9: 'no other corporate actions ... such as stock splits, reverse stock splits, stock dividends, bonus shares ...') list only bond issues and the 2025 buybacks. corporate_actions is therefore empty and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Related-party sales: about 70% of net sales go to affiliated distributors/companies (e.g. PT Inbisco Niagatama Semesta and overseas Mayora affiliates; FS2025 Note 34; 9M2026 Note 25: 70.52%), and related-party receivables were Rp8.16 tn at end-2025 (26% of total assets).

Cash-flow note: the 9M cash-flow statements show 'Dividen - Perusahaan' of 1,341,914,953,500 (9M2026) and 1,250,636,184,875 (9M2025), more than the AGMS totals (1,321,601,053,500 / 1,226,376,234,875); the full-year FS2025 line equals the AGMS total. Not used for any stored value.

Website terms (https://www.mayoraindah.co.id/terms-and-condition) forbid 'creating an alternative database ... by systematically downloading and storing any part or all contents of the Site' - reviewer: only the public filings listed in sources.md were downloaded, for citation.
